result.summary: Identified two minor visual and content issues related to badge logic and text overflow.

issues.description: A discount badge displays '-0%', which provides no value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Implement logic to hide the discount tag when the value is zero.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the horizontal scroll view.
issues.suggestion: Adjust font size or layout to prevent text clipping for longer titles.
